prompt: The avatar menu in the top bar re-renders whenever anything happens in the app, for example on every keystroke in the issue filter.

truth.summary: AccountMenu passes useAppSelector a selector that returns a new { user, savedViewCount } object, and useSelector compares with ===, so every dispatched action re-renders it.

referenceAnswer.cause: The useAppSelector selector returns a new object literal on every call, so the reference check fails after every action.

decoyAnswers.cause: Dropdown is a class component that re-renders its children.
TopBar re-renders AccountMenu on every action.

referenceFix.replace:
const user = useAppSelector((state) => state.session.user)
  const savedViewCount = useAppSelector((state) => state.savedViews.views.length)

genieEvidence.notes: react_render_causes reports external-store (inferred). react-redux 8's development stability check also logs 'Selector unknown returned a different result' in the browser console, which Genie does not surface.
